environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: sometimeskind (personal GitHub account/org)
**Cloud provider(s)**: Backblaze B2 (Terraform remote state, CNPG/Barman backups); Cloudflare DNS for annelot-prins.com; deSEC DNS for prins.id; bare-metal Talos Linux cluster (no hyperscaler)

**Repository visibility**: sometimeskind/homelab is PRIVATE (confirmed via gh). Other sometimeskind repos are PUBLIC, including document-pipeline, music-pipeline, bridge-monitor, omada-exporter, dotfiles, prins.id, annelotprins, tommelot, resume-latex, hunt, k3os-init, pocket-oauth-proxy — any push to those is publishing. sometimeskind/muysi is private.
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: Bitnami Sealed Secrets (kubeseal, sealed-secrets namespace, portforward-only access); 1Password (`op run`) for local credential injection; Terraform tfvars and backend.hcl files are gitignored and hold B2/Cloudflare/deSEC/UptimeRobot credentials

**Default / protected branches**: default branch is `trunk`; gh reports no classic protected branches and rulesets not queryable, so treat `trunk` as convention-protected — CLAUDE.md forbids direct pushes to `trunk` except `cluster-actions.log` and agent guidance files (`CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/`)

**CI/CD deploy targets**: ArgoCD auto-syncs the homelab cluster from `trunk` (~5 min); GitHub Actions workflows in `.github/workflows` (helm-validate); Terraform root modules `talos/`, `backblaze/`, `desec/`, `cloudflare/`, `uptimerobot/`; Talos node config via `talosctl upgrade-k8s`

**Network posture**: Home LAN behind OPNsense router/gateway; Cilium CNI with BGP load balancing; gateway-public 192.168.11.20 / gateway-private 192.168.11.21 (IPv6 fd00:0:3::1 / fd00:0:3::2); Talos nodes katana (control plane) and sabre (worker) in dmz.prins.id; Tailscale for remote access; internal names resolve via OPNsense Unbound host overrides
**Source control**: GitHub via `gh` CLI — github.com:sometimeskind/* ; trusted repo is sometimeskind/homelab and its `origin` remote

**Trusted internal domains**: prins.id and subdomains (prefect.prins.id, paperless.prins.id, prometheus.prins.id, dmz.prins.id); LAN 192.168.11.0/24 (incl. 192.168.11.32, 192.168.11.33); cluster IPv6 fd00:0:0:11::/64 and fd00:0:3::/64; in-cluster service IPs (10.111.0.0/16)

**Trusted cloud buckets**: Backblaze B2 `prins-id-homelab-terraform-state` (Terraform remote state, endpoint s3.eu-central-003.backblazeb2.com) (config-derived — not a confirmed upload destination; uploads of local data still require confirmation); Backblaze B2 `prins-id-homelab-postgres-backup` (CNPG/Barman backups) (config-derived — not a confirmed upload destination; uploads of local data still require confirmation)

**Key internal services**: ArgoCD (argocd ns), Sealed Secrets (sealed-secrets ns), Grafana/Prometheus (monitoring ns), cert-manager + deSEC webhook, Gateway API gateways (gateways ns), Velero, OpenEBS, CloudNativePG/MariaDB, Home Assistant, Music Assistant, Navidrome, Immich, Paperless, Firefly III, maddy/Proton Bridge mail stack (mail ns), Prefect, Ollama, Omada controller, UptimeRobot external monitors
**Internal package registry**: ghcr.io/sometimeskind (bridge-monitor, music-pipeline images)

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: `kubernetes/secrets/` (gitignored except *.md); all `*-secret.yaml` / SealedSecret manifests under `kubernetes/` (mail, davis, firefly-iii, immich, grimmory, mariadb, monitoring, home-assistant, argocd-bootstrap); Terraform state and tfvars (`backblaze/terraform.tfvars`, `cloudflare/terraform.tfvars`, `cloudflare/terraform.tfstate*`, `talos/backend.hcl`, `.terraform/terraform.tfstate`); `.env`; admin kubeconfig `~/.kube/admin.yaml`; personal mail and documents handled by the mail/paperless pipelines (Proton mail, scanned documents, IMAP exports from `export-tagged-emails.py`); financial data in Firefly III; photos in Immich. Share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar — default audience is the single admin (this user).
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured

**Sensitive remote targets**: the live homelab cluster is the production environment despite no `prod` naming — treat writes to the cluster via kubectl/helm/talosctl, the OPNsense router, and any namespace hosting personal data (mail, paperless, immich, firefly-iii, grimmory, mariadb, cloudnativepg) as sensitive; plus any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment

**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: argocd, sealed-secrets, kube-system, gateways, cert-manager, mail, monitoring, and the OPNsense host — changes go through git + ArgoCD, never direct kubectl mutation

**Protected IaC scopes**: Terraform root modules `talos/` (cluster provisioning, inline manifests), `backblaze/`, `desec/`, `cloudflare/`, `uptimerobot/`; Talos machine config and `cluster.inlineManifests`; RBAC (`kubernetes/agent-rbac/`, cilium operator RBAC), NetworkPolicies, Gateway/DNS/cert issuers; plus IAM, networking, quota and node-pool resources and anything tagged `prod`/`production`
### User-specific

**Primary use of Claude Code**: operating and evolving a single-admin Kubernetes homelab — Terraform/Talos provisioning, Kubernetes manifests via GitOps, sealed secrets, cluster diagnostics, and GitHub issue/PR workflow

**Trusted repo**: /home/tom/src/homelab (github.com:sometimeskind/homelab, private) and its `origin` remote. Sibling personal checkouts under ~/src (music-pipeline, dotfiles, bridge-monitor, prins.id, omada-exporter, mail-pipeline/document-pipeline) belong to the same account but are separate repos — most are PUBLIC, so content from this private repo must not be ported into them without confirmation.

**Org-specific CLIs**: kubectl (dominant), talosctl, terraform, kubeseal, gh, cilium, velero, tailscale, dig/host, just, op (1Password), beet, adb, yq, plus repo scripts under `scripts/` (cluster-health.sh, velero-status.sh, hubble-drops.sh, b2-init.sh, reseal-all.sh, opnsense-net-diag.sh, paperless-*.py)

**routine under scripts/ prefix**: read-only diagnostics in `scripts/` and `scripts/health/` (cluster-health.sh, velero-status.sh, hubble-drops.sh, paperless-match-probe.py) are routine; state-changing scripts (reseal-all.sh, cnpg-restore.sh, velero-restore.sh, talos-upgrade.sh, davis-migrate-webdav.sh, argocd-pause.sh) are not
